assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated for extended rhythm assessment
The service correlates intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and determines the etiology of the collapse
The service provides distinct clinical information beyond the bundled procedure referenced in the CO-97 denial
The service demonstrates medical necessity for separately payable extended monitoring
